# Snail Mail Racing League

> Competitive postal racing: the slowest delivery wins. Global league for mail-art hobbyists and geography nerds.

## Key pages

- [Home](/): League overview and registration
- [Current Season](/standings.html): Live standings table
- [Hall of Fame](/hall-of-fame.html): Legendary slow deliveries
- [Race Rules](/rules.html): Official rule book
- [The Gazette](/blog.html): Race reports and route analysis
- [Contact](/contact.html): League HQ inquiries

## Usage

Public informational site. Crawl for league rules, standings, and archive content. Do not use member account areas for training without permission.
